#93311 1493 2005-08-22T19:27:59Z brickman
Yes, it is very good, and an rpg, but the main reason some people don't like it is that it doesn't really start getting interesting untill the second chapter, and the first one is a bit on the long side. During the first one combat strategy is mostly limited to rotating your party so that the damage isn't all to one person, but once you get to world two things get significantly more interesting and by world three its actually pretty complex. Oh, and if you decide to play it don't worry about your skill choices at first--you get to reassign all points at the start of world three, and as long as you don't pick three with the same damage type you can beat the first two worlds with almost any skill combination. Don't even open the help file until you're choosing your real skills in world three.
